messages.subject: RE: Caspian Atlas Subscription Agreement — responding mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

Our responding mark-up (v3) is attached. In summary: liability cap moved to 150% of trailing 12-month fees (down from your 200%); the blanket data-protection carve-out removed; payment terms back to net 30; and the non-renewal notice restored to 90 days. On the SLA we can offer 99.7% availability with an enhanced service-credit table, which I'll send separately.

I think we are close. Shall we aim to finalise before the holidays?

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com

messages.subject: RE: Caspian Atlas Subscription Agreement — responding mark-up (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We can accept 150% and net 30. On data protection, the client will drop the carve-out provided there is a separate sub-limit; if you can live with 200% for data-protection liabilities specifically we have a deal. 99.7% SLA is acceptable. I'll confirm the data-protection point with Harborlight and revert, but I'd regard the commercial terms as agreed.

Adam
